handoffs.message: Helper-claimed by Claude while Codex completes higher-priority work.

KW-03 Evidence Ref contract published. Deliverables: (1) docs/bff/KW-03-evidence-refs.md — full list/detail route contract, link-type taxonomy, credibility metadata, BFF-owned resolved_link, linked_decisions panel, source_note_context/source_memory_context, non-goals, degradation rules; (2) docs/examples/KW-03-evidence-refs.json — four example payloads covering list, detail from postmortem, detail from research note, and degraded list; (3) PACKET_FAMILY.md updated — KW-03 Lovable readiness gate flipped to true, module inventory updated, backend gap matrix rows marked resolved. All three acceptance criteria met: evidence list and detail routes published, link resolution is BFF-owned, evidence drilldowns no longer guess targets from raw refs.

Review finding: docs/pantheon-handoffs/KW-006-knowledge-workbench/PACKET_FAMILY.md still marks the three KW-01 prerequisite rows as missing in the Backend Gap Matrix (GET /api/v1/knowledge/memory, GET /api/v1/knowledge/memory/{entry_id}, and Memory entry lifecycle and identity contract). That contradicts the header/module readiness claims and Promotion Criteria item 5, so KW-03 cannot claim its upstream prerequisites are already Lovable-ready until the matrix is reconciled. Please resolve the PACKET_FAMILY contradiction and re-handoff for review.

PACKET_FAMILY.md contradiction resolved: the three KW-01 Backend Gap Matrix rows (GET /api/v1/knowledge/memory, GET /api/v1/knowledge/memory/{entry_id}, Memory entry lifecycle and identity contract) were incorrectly marked as 'missing' while the KW-01 module section and Lovable readiness gate already showed them as 'implemented'/'true'. All three rows now correctly read 'resolved — docs/bff/KW-01-institutional-memory.md', consistent with the module inventory, module backend-gaps table, packetization prerequisite, and Promotion Criteria item 5. Ready for re-review.

Review finding: docs/lovable/PANTHEON_FRONTEND_SA.md still marks KW-03 as blocked shell-only in the Knowledge workbench summary, route map, and page readiness table (/knowledge/evidence and /knowledge/evidence/:ref_id). That contradicts docs/pantheon-handoffs/KW-006-knowledge-workbench/PACKET_FAMILY.md and the published KW-03 contract/examples, so Lovable-facing readiness is not yet globally consistent. Please update the frontend SA to mark KW-03 as contract-ready/ready wherever evidence routes are listed, then re-handoff for review.

PANTHEON_FRONTEND_SA.md now globally consistent with KW-03 contract: workbench summary updated to KW-01-03 contract-ready, route map rows changed from blocked-shell to contract-published, knowledge page list rows changed from blocked to contract-ready, and section 12.3.4 rewritten with full contract-state description. Ready for re-review.
